# Script overview: 
This script cleans CA State Water Resources Control Board (SWRCB) Annual Compliance Report (ACR) data and joins it to key covariates from the US EPA's SDWA SDWIS dataset.

# Inputs:
- 2020-2024 ACR data, all downloaded 8/26/25 from the CA SWRCB Division of Drinking Water (DDW) (via https://www.waterboards.ca.gov/drinking_water/certlic/drinkingwater/Publications.html):
    - "raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr_2020_dataset.xlsx"
    - "raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2021-dataset.xlsx"
    - "raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2022-dataset.xlsx"
    - "raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2023-dataset.xlsx"
    - "raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2024-dataset.xlsx"
    
- “raw_data/SDWA_latest_downloads/SDWA_PUB_WATER_SYSTEMS.csv" (Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) public water system file downloaded 1/17/25 from USEPA SDWIS/ECHO: https://echo.epa.gov/files/echodownloads/SDWA_latest_downloads.zip downloaded from https://echo.epa.gov/tools/data-downloads; data download summary: https://echo.epa.gov/tools/data-downloads/sdwa-download-summary; date data extracted: 1/11/2025 noted on https://echo.epa.gov/resources/echo-data/about-the-data)

- "processed_data/universe_pwsids.rds" (created in script 01)

# Key outputs:
- "outputs/acr_df_for_analysis.csv" (used in subsequent scripts)

# Requires:
- pacman, tidyverse, janitor, sf, lubridate, mapview, readxl


# 0. setup (always run these)

```{r}
# Install pacman if not present
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("pacman")

# Check, install missing, and load all packages in one call
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, # general purpose
               janitor,#  tidying dataframes
               sf, # spatial work
               lubridate, # dates
               mapview,# mapping
               readxl) # read excel files

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

```{r useful functions}

# %notin%: operator that returns the negation of %in%
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

# count_df_na: takes a dataframe and returns counts of NA values in each column
count_df_na <- function(df) {
  sapply(df, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
}

# view_flat: quick look at sf objects w/o geometry
view_flat <- function(df) {
  st_drop_geometry(df) %>% 
    View()
}

```


# step 3. using swrcb acr data, create cleaned dataset of 2020-2024 violations

## 3a. load and clean acr data
```{r load and clean acr data}
################################################################################
################################################################################
### load

# 1 tab
acr20_orig <- read_xlsx("raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr_2020_dataset.xlsx")

# 2 tabs - both relevant
acr21_orig_fed_viols <- read_xlsx("raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2021-dataset.xlsx",
                                  sheet = "acr_2021_Federal_Violations")
acr21_orig_state_viols <- read_xlsx("raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2021-dataset.xlsx",
                                  sheet = "acr_2021_State_Violations")

# 2 tabs - only need violations tab
acr22_orig <- read_xlsx("raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2022-dataset.xlsx",
                        sheet = "acr_2022_violations")

# 1 tab
acr23_orig <- read_xlsx("raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2023-dataset.xlsx")

# 2 tabs - group and single
acr24_orig_group <- read_xlsx("raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2024-dataset.xlsx", 
                               sheet = "2024_group_violations")
acr24_orig_single <- read_xlsx("raw_data/ddw_acrs/acr-2024-dataset.xlsx", 
                               sheet = "2024_single_violations")
  

################################################################################
################################################################################
### clean

# clean names for each
acr20cl <- acr20_orig %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

acr21_fed_viols_cl <- acr21_orig_fed_viols %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

acr21_state_viols_cl <- acr21_orig_state_viols %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

acr22cl <- acr22_orig %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

acr23cl <- acr23_orig %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

acr24_group_cl <- acr24_orig_group %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

acr24_single_cl <- acr24_orig_single %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

################################################################################
# 2020

# rename for consistency: pwsid, viol_type, viol_name, contaminant, 
acr20 <- acr20cl %>% 
  rename(pwsid = pws_number, 
         viol_type = category_code, 
         viol_subtype = name,
         contaminant = analyte) %>% 
  mutate(year = "2020") %>% 
  select(pwsid, viol_type, viol_subtype, contaminant, year) %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c(
    # health-based
    "MCL", "TT", 
    # monitoring and reporting
    "MON", # major and minor
    "PN", # notification; only 1 PN violation for a state notification rule in 2020
    "RPT")) # eg. failure to complete annual report, 
            # state reporting requirement violations, ccr report,
            # but 1 notification re: e coli
                          
# checked each viol_type
acr20 %>% filter(viol_type == "MCL") %>% count(viol_subtype) %>% arrange(desc(n)) 
  # note: MCL includes secondary MCLs


################################################################################
# 2021

# rename for consistency: pwsid, viol_type, viol_name, contaminant, 
acr21_fed <- acr21_fed_viols_cl %>% 
  rename(pwsid = number0, 
         viol_type = category_code, 
         viol_subtype = name,
         contaminant = analyte) %>% 
  mutate(year = "2021") %>% 
  select(pwsid, viol_type, viol_subtype, contaminant, year,
         tmnviol_is_number) %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c(
    # health-based
    "MCL", "TT", 
    # monitoring and reporting
    "MON", # major and minor
    "PN", # public notice rule linked to violation; state notification
    "RPT")) # eg. failure to complete annual report, 
            # state reporting requirement violations, ccr report,
            # but 1 notification re: e coli

# checked each viol_type
acr21_fed %>% filter(viol_type == "MCL") %>% count(viol_subtype) %>% arrange(desc(n)) 
  # no 2ndary MCLs listed here

# rename for consistency: pwsid, viol_type, viol_name, contaminant, 
acr21_state <- acr21_state_viols_cl %>% 
  rename(pwsid = number0, 
         viol_type = category_code, 
         viol_subtype = name,
         contaminant = analyte) %>% 
  mutate(year = "2021") %>% 
  select(pwsid, viol_type, viol_subtype, contaminant, year,
         tmnviol_is_number) %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c(
    # health-based
    "MCL", "TT", 
    # monitoring and reporting
    "MON", # major and minor
    "PN", # none this year
    "RPT")) # eg. failure to complete annual report, 
            # state reporting requirement violations, ccr report,
            # but 1 notification re: e coli

# checked each viol_type
acr21_state %>% filter(viol_type == "MCL") %>% count(viol_subtype) %>% arrange(desc(n)) 
    # note: MCL includes secondary MCLs here

# both state and federal have a "state primary mcl - not cr6" subtype, so i'll check those to make sure they're not duplicated entries
#acr21_fed %>% filter(viol_type == "MCL" & viol_subtype == "STATE PRIMARY MCL VIOL - NOT CR6") %>% view()

#acr21_state %>% filter(viol_type == "MCL" & viol_subtype == "STATE PRIMARY MCL VIOL - NOT CR6") %>% view() 
  # from manual inspection, these are not duplicate entries; there are different PWSIDs on each list

# join state and federal for 2021
names(acr21_state) == names(acr21_fed) # true

acr21_prep <- acr21_state %>% 
  bind_rows(acr21_fed)
 
# double check that they're all unique, using tmnviol_is_number
nrow(acr21_prep) # 2972
length(unique(acr21_prep$tmnviol_is_number)) # 2815
acr21_chk_tmnviol <- acr21_prep %>% 
  group_by(tmnviol_is_number) %>% 
  filter(tmnviol_is_number != "") %>% 
  add_count() %>% 
  filter(n>1) 

#view(acr21_chk_tmnviol)
nrow(acr21_chk_tmnviol) # 246
max(acr21_chk_tmnviol$n) # 2
  # 246/2 = 123 violations with the same tmnviol_is_number
nrow(acr21_prep) # 2972 
123/(2972-123) # 4%

# remove column that's no longer needed
acr21 <- acr21_prep %>% 
  select(-tmnviol_is_number)
  

################################################################################
# 2022

# rename for consistency: pwsid, viol_type, viol_name, contaminant, 
acr22 <- acr22cl %>% 
  rename(pwsid = number0, 
         viol_type = category_code, 
         viol_subtype = name,
         contaminant = analytegroup_nm) %>% 
  mutate(year = "2022") %>% 
  select(pwsid, viol_type, viol_subtype, contaminant, year) %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c(
    # health-based
    "MCL", "TT", 
    # monitoring and reporting
    "MON", # major and minor
    "PN", # public notice rule
    "RPT")) # eg. failure to complete annual report, 
            # state reporting requirement violations, ccr report,
            # but 1 notification re: e coli
                          
# checked each viol_type
acr22 %>% filter(viol_type == "MCL") %>% count(viol_subtype) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  print(n = nrow(.))
  # note: MCL includes secondary MCLs 



################################################################################
# 2023

# rename for consistency: pwsid, viol_type, viol_name, contaminant, 
acr23 <- acr23cl %>% 
  rename(viol_type = viol_category, 
         viol_subtype = violation_type_name,
         contaminant = analyte_name) %>% 
  mutate(year = "2023") %>% 
  select(pwsid, viol_type, viol_subtype, contaminant, year) %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c(
    # health-based
    "MCL", "TT", 
    # monitoring and reporting
    "MON", # major and minor
    "PN", # public notice rule
    "RPT")) # eg. failure to complete annual report, 
            # state reporting requirement violations, ccr report,
            # but 1 notification re: e coli
                          
# checked each viol_type
acr23 %>% filter(viol_type == "MCL") %>% count(viol_subtype) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  print(n = nrow(.))
  # note: MCL includes secondary MCLs 

# first time i've seen a "POU/POE MCL" as the "rule type" - investigate
#acr23 %>% filter(viol_type == "MCL" & viol_subtype == "POU/POE MCL") %>% view()
  # we will include this

################################################################################
# 2024

## group tab
# rename for consistency: pwsid, viol_type, viol_name, contaminant, 
acr24_group <- acr24_group_cl %>% 
  rename(viol_type = viol_category, 
         viol_subtype = violation_type_name,
         contaminant = analyte_name) %>% 
  mutate(year = "2024") %>% 
  select(pwsid, viol_type, viol_subtype, contaminant, year) %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c(
    # health-based
    "MCL", "TT", 
    # monitoring and reporting
    "MON", # major and minor
    "PN", # public notice rule
    "RPT")) # eg. failure to complete annual report, 
            # state reporting requirement violations, ccr report,
            # but 1 notification re: e coli
                          
# checked each viol_type
acr24_group %>% filter(viol_type == "MON") %>% count(viol_subtype) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  print(n = nrow(.))
  # all monitoring violations

## single tab
# rename for consistency: pwsid, viol_type, viol_name, contaminant, 
acr24_single <- acr24_single_cl %>% 
  rename(viol_type = viol_category, 
         viol_subtype = violation_type_name,
         contaminant = analyte_name) %>% 
  mutate(year = "2024") %>% 
  select(pwsid, viol_type, viol_subtype, contaminant, year) %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c(
    # health-based
    "MCL", "TT", 
    # monitoring and reporting
    "MON", # major and minor
    "PN", # public notice rule
    "RPT")) # eg. failure to complete annual report, 
            # state reporting requirement violations, ccr report,
            # but 1 notification re: e coli
                          
# checked each viol_type
acr24_single %>% filter(viol_type == "MCL") %>% count(viol_subtype) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  print(n = nrow(.))
  # includes secondary MCL and POU/POE MCL

# combine those tabs
names(acr24_group) == names(acr24_single)

acr24 <- acr24_group %>% 
  bind_rows(acr24_single)

################################################################################
### combine all years

# confirm same names
names(acr20) == names(acr21)
names(acr20) == names(acr22)
names(acr20) == names(acr23)
names(acr20) == names(acr24)

# bind rows
all_acrs <- bind_rows(list(acr20, acr21, acr22, acr23, acr24))

nrow(all_acrs) == nrow(acr20) + nrow(acr21) + nrow(acr22) + nrow(acr23) + 
  nrow(acr24) 

################################################################################
################################################################################
### save
saveRDS(all_acrs, "processed_data/all_acrs.rds")

```


## 3b. create annual violation counts by system
```{r}

################################################################################
################################################################################
### load data

# universe of pwsids (based on usepa sdwis)
universe_pwsids <- readRDS("processed_data/universe_pwsids.rds")
length(universe_pwsids) # 4301

# acr data (swrcb ddw)
all_acrs <- readRDS("processed_data/all_acrs.rds")
dim(all_acrs) # 14938     5

# usepa sdwis (echo data)
pws_list <- read_csv("raw_data/SDWA_latest_downloads/SDWA_PUB_WATER_SYSTEMS.csv")
  # note: one warning message that is not relevant for our purposes
nrow(pws_list) # 431754


################################################################################
# health-based (MCL and TT)
health <- all_acrs %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c("TT", "MCL"))

nrow(health) # 6681

# count per pwsid per year
health_per_pwsid_per_year <- health %>% 
  group_by(pwsid, year) %>%
  mutate(annual_health_n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(pwsid, year, annual_health_n)
summary(health_per_pwsid_per_year$annual_health_n)

# count per pwsid per year, tt only
health_per_year_tt_count <- health %>% 
  filter(viol_type == "TT") %>% 
  group_by(pwsid, year) %>%
  mutate(annual_tt = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(pwsid, year, annual_tt)
summary(health_per_year_tt_count$annual_tt)

# count per pwsid per year, mcl only
health_per_year_mcl_count <- health %>% 
  filter(viol_type == "MCL") %>% 
  group_by(pwsid, year) %>%
  mutate(annual_mcl = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(pwsid, year, annual_mcl)
summary(health_per_year_mcl_count$annual_mcl)

# count per pwsid per year, mcl only, w/o 2ndary mcl
health_per_year_count_no_2ndary_mcl <- health %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c("MCL", "TT")) %>% 
  filter(viol_subtype != "§64449 SECONDARY MCL") %>% 
  group_by(pwsid, year) %>%
  mutate(annual_health_no_2ndary = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(pwsid, year, annual_health_no_2ndary)
summary(health_per_year_count_no_2ndary_mcl$annual_health_no_2ndary)

# count per pwsid per year, tt only w/o lsl
health_per_year_count_no_2ndary_or_lsl_inventory <- health %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c("MCL", "TT")) %>% 
  filter(viol_subtype != "§64449 SECONDARY MCL") %>% 
  filter(viol_subtype != "LSL INVENTORY-INITIAL") %>% 
  group_by(pwsid, year) %>%
  mutate(annual_health_no_2ndary_or_lsl_inventory = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(pwsid, year, annual_health_no_2ndary_or_lsl_inventory)
summary(health_per_year_count_no_2ndary_or_lsl_inventory$annual_health_no_2ndary_or_lsl_inventory)

# join
health_data <- health_per_pwsid_per_year %>% 
  left_join(health_per_year_tt_count, by = c("pwsid", "year")) %>%
  left_join(health_per_year_mcl_count, by = c("pwsid", "year")) %>% 
  left_join(health_per_year_count_no_2ndary_mcl, by = c("pwsid", "year")) %>% 
  left_join(health_per_year_count_no_2ndary_or_lsl_inventory, by = c("pwsid", "year"))



################################################################################
# monitoring/reporting (MON, PN, RPT)
mr <- all_acrs %>% 
  filter(viol_type %in% c("MON", "PN", "RPT"))

nrow(mr) # 8257

# count per pwsid per year
mr_per_pwsid_per_year <- mr %>% 
  group_by(pwsid, year) %>%
  mutate(annual_mr_n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(pwsid, year, annual_mr_n)
summary(mr_per_pwsid_per_year$annual_mr_n)

# count per pwsid per year, MON only
mr_per_year_mon_count <- mr %>% 
  filter(viol_type == "MON") %>% 
  group_by(pwsid, year) %>%
  mutate(annual_mon = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(pwsid, year, annual_mon)
summary(mr_per_year_mon_count$annual_mon)

# count per pwsid per year, PN only
mr_per_year_pn_count <- mr %>% 
  filter(viol_type == "PN") %>% 
  group_by(pwsid, year) %>%
  mutate(annual_pn = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(pwsid, year, annual_pn)
summary(mr_per_year_pn_count$annual_pn)

# count per pwsid per year, RPT only
mr_per_year_rpt_count <- mr %>% 
  filter(viol_type == "RPT") %>% 
  group_by(pwsid, year) %>%
  mutate(annual_rpt = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(pwsid, year, annual_rpt)
summary(mr_per_year_rpt_count$annual_rpt)

# join
mr_data <- mr_per_pwsid_per_year %>% 
  left_join(mr_per_year_mon_count, by = c("pwsid", "year")) %>%
  left_join(mr_per_year_pn_count, by = c("pwsid", "year")) %>% 
  left_join(mr_per_year_rpt_count, by = c("pwsid", "year"))

################################################################################
# combine 
all_viols_by_pwsid_by_year <- health_data %>% 
  full_join(mr_data, by = c("pwsid", "year"))

# list all PWSs in study over time frame
universe_pwsid_years <- universe_pwsids %>% 
  crossing(c(2020:2024)) 
colnames(universe_pwsid_years) <- c("pwsid","year")
universe_pwsid_years <- universe_pwsid_years %>% 
  mutate(year = as.character(year))

# join violation data to that otherwise empty dataframe
all_pwsids_viols_per_year <- universe_pwsid_years %>% 
  left_join(all_viols_by_pwsid_by_year, by = c("pwsid", "year")) %>% 
  # set NAs to 0
  mutate(across(annual_health_n:annual_rpt, 
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .)))

################################################################################
# create measures that look over the entire 5-year time period

# create 5-year count & binary variables for health and monitoring violations
five_year_measures <- all_pwsids_viols_per_year %>% 
  group_by(pwsid) %>% 
  # create 5-year count variables 
  summarize(health_5yr_count = sum(annual_health_n),
            health_5yr_count_no2ndary_mcl = sum(annual_health_no_2ndary),
            health_5yr_count_no_2ndary_or_lsl = sum(annual_health_no_2ndary_or_lsl_inventory),
            mr_5yr_count = sum(annual_mr_n),
            mon_only_5yr_count = sum(annual_mon)) %>% 
  # create binary variables
  mutate(health_5yr_binary = as.numeric(ifelse(health_5yr_count == 0,
                                    "0", "1")),
         health_5yr_no2ndary_mcl_binary = as.numeric(ifelse(health_5yr_count_no2ndary_mcl == 0,
                                    "0", "1")),
         health_5yr_no2ndary_or_lsl_binary = as.numeric(ifelse(health_5yr_count_no_2ndary_or_lsl == 0,
                                    "0", "1")),
         mr_5yr_binary = as.numeric(ifelse(mr_5yr_count == 0,
                                    "0", "1")),
         mon_only_5yr_binary = as.numeric(ifelse(mon_only_5yr_count == 0,
                                    "0", "1")))

summary(five_year_measures)

################################################################################
# add covariates from USEPA SDWA data (ECHO - SDWIS)

# clean usepa sdwis echo data
pws_list_cl <- pws_list %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

# add covariates from usepa sdwis echo data
five_year_measures_w_all_covariates <- five_year_measures %>% 
  left_join(pws_list_cl, by = "pwsid") 

table(five_year_measures_w_all_covariates$pws_type_code)

# select relevant covariates
df_w_all_covariates <- five_year_measures_w_all_covariates %>% 
  dplyr::select(pwsid:mon_only_5yr_binary, 
                pws_name, 
                
                # system type
                pws_type_code, # binary (cws or ntnc)
                
                # source water
                gw_sw_code, # binary (gw or sw)
                primary_source_code, # categorical, 5 categories
                
                # 2 options for system size
                population_served_count, 
                service_connections_count
                )
  
table(df_w_all_covariates$gw_sw_code) 




################################################################################
################################################################################
### save

saveRDS(health_data, "processed_data/health_data.rds")
saveRDS(mr_data, "processed_data/mr_data.rds")

saveRDS(all_pwsids_viols_per_year, "processed_data/all_pwsids_viols_per_year.rds")
write_csv(all_pwsids_viols_per_year, "processed_data/all_pwsids_viols_per_year.csv")

saveRDS(five_year_measures, "processed_data/five_year_measures.rds")
write_csv(five_year_measures, "processed_data/five_year_measures.csv")

saveRDS(df_w_all_covariates, "processed_data/df_w_all_covariates.rds")
write_csv(df_w_all_covariates, "processed_data/df_w_all_covariates.csv")

```


# 3c. join outcome data to typology data
```{r}
################################################################################
################################################################################
### load
typology <- readRDS("processed_data/typology.rds")
dim(typology) # 4301   55

df_w_all_covariates <- readRDS("processed_data/df_w_all_covariates.rds")
dim(df_w_all_covariates) # 4301   11

typology_simple <- typology %>% 
  dplyr::select(pwsid_echo, carceral_sys)


################################################################################
### join

acr_df_for_analysis <- df_w_all_covariates %>% 
  left_join(typology_simple, by = c("pwsid" = "pwsid_echo"))

saveRDS(acr_df_for_analysis, "processed_data/acr_df_for_analysis.rds")
write.csv(acr_df_for_analysis, "outputs/acr_df_for_analysis.csv")

```
